def _execute_run(
    run_id: str,
    team_profile: str,
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    store: Optional[RunStateStore] = None,
) -> None:
    run_store = store or _get_module_run_store()
    handler = _TEAM_HANDLERS.get(team_profile)
    if handler is None:
        _update_run(
            run_id,
            store=run_store,
            status="failed",
            error=f"Unknown team_profile: {team_profile}",
        )
        _append_run_event(
            run_id,
            "run_failed",
            {"error": f"Unknown team_profile: {team_profile}"},
            store=run_store,
        )
        return

    _update_run(
        run_id,
        store=run_store,
        status="running",
        started_at=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
    )
    _append_run_event(
        run_id,
        "run_started",
        {"team_profile": team_profile},
        store=run_store,
    )

    def emit_run_event(event_type: str, payload_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        _append_run_event(run_id, event_type, payload_data, store=run_store)

    handler_payload = dict(payload)
    handler_payload["_run_id"] = run_id
    handler_payload["_emit_event"] = emit_run_event

    try:
        result = handler(handler_payload)
        _update_run(
            run_id,
            store=run_store,
            status="completed",
            finished_at=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            result=result,
        )
        _append_run_event(
            run_id, "run_finished", {"result": result}, store=run_store
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Run %s failed", run_id)
        _update_run(
            run_id,
            store=run_store,
            status="failed",
            finished_at=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            error=str(exc),
        )
        _append_run_event(
            run_id, "run_failed", {"error": str(exc)}, store=run_store
        )
